headline: Twenty-five US states sue over new Trump tariffs
summary: A coalition sued to block 10–12.5% duties on goods from 60 trading partners, including the UK, China and the European Union.
script: Twenty-five US states are suing to block new Trump tariffs on goods from dozens of trading partners. The duties, ranging from ten to twelve-point-five percent, affect the UK, China and the European Union as the legal fight begins.
